0022600214.text: The Utah Jazz (1-9, 15th in the West, on an eight-game losing streak) host the Miami Heat (4-6, 8th in the East, on a one-game win streak) in the Jazz's 11th game of the season. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Keyonte George (ankle) and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Miami has no listed absences. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and the Jazz won the most recent meeting 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026, though they have not yet played each other this season.
